stage: P4 only; before any fitting outcome
reason: The complete-action fixture reveals successful alternatives outside the old selected/maximum-progress pair. Refitting just that pair would not test correction of the newly established ranking losses.
change: Use all original deployment-safe candidates from each of the same 38 preregistered roots, rather than two candidates, in both matched fitted arms
unchanged: Parent weights and frozen feature encoder
terminal_samples: Do not fit terminal V labels; their candidate score is the actual terminal reward for every head
metrics: Held-out all-candidate ranking residuals and the fixed-world return/outcome of each head's preferred first candidate followed by the original frozen GRU. This is offline selection from an already evaluated catalogue, not a new-head closed-loop rollout.
causal_scope: Only contrast between the two fitted heads isolates label source. Compared with the original head both arms add the same counterfactual coverage, so improvement does not identify original training cause.
